display.purpose: Rare workspace identities and dominant mode declarations.

headline.purpose: Major workspace headings and selected object identities.

title.purpose: Window titles and compact command-group headings.

body.purpose: Agent responses, guidance, and longer status copy.

meta.purpose: Paths, counters, timestamps, capabilities, and secondary state.

shadows.name: status-emission
shadows.purpose: Local live marker, selected node, or active route terminal.

shadows.name: active-emission
shadows.purpose: Restrained working-state halo attached to its owner.

shadows.name: transient-command-menu
shadows.purpose: Depth reserved for a temporary desktop, Explorer, or taskbar command menu above the working surface.

shadows.name: actionable-notice
shadows.purpose: Persistent warning or error notice that must remain legible above the taskbar until acknowledged.

shadows.name: linked-drawer
shadows.purpose: Narrow-layout Agent drawer separation; never used on resting panels.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Immediate control and taskbar state response.

motion.name: linked-layout
motion.purpose: Explorer and Agent causal-workspace layout transition.

motion.name: route-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal the one currently active relation route.

motion.name: core-deemphasis
motion.purpose: Knowledge-graph opacity and filter transition when managed work takes focus.

motion.name: telemetry-toggle
motion.purpose: Compact disclosure-chevron response in the telemetry rail.

motion.name: agent-working-signal
motion.purpose: Discrete Agent working-state pulse rather than ambient decoration.

motion.name: vector-flow
motion.purpose: Low-frequency motion on a genuinely live knowledge route.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable nonessential animation under prefers-reduced-motion or the shell's reduced-motion setting.

components.name: Command Button
components.description: A square tactical action with a sparse orange focus response.
components.css: .ds-command-button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--structure, rgba(245,241,233,.28)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--void, #000); color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-command-button:hover { color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); border-color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); } .ds-command-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-command-button:active { box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00) inset; }

components.name: Active Command Button
components.description: The armed command variant: selected or executable, never a decorative orange state.
components.css: .ds-command-button-active { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); border-radius: 0; background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00) inset; font: 600 11px/1 var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-command-button-active:hover { background: var(--signal-fill-strong, rgb(255 106 0 / 7%)); } .ds-command-button-active:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-command-button-active:active { box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00) inset; }

components.name: Command Input
components.description: A black high-contrast field for search, commands, and directives.
components.css: .ds-command-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-command-field input { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--structure-strong, rgba(245,241,233,.54)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--void, #000); color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font: 13px/1.45 var(--font-body, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-command-field input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); } .ds-command-field input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 106 0 / 28%) inset; }

components.name: HUD Panel
components.description: An open instrument region defined by a ledger line and one command tick.
components.css: .ds-hud-panel { width: 280px; border: 0; border-top: .5px solid var(--structure, rgba(245,241,233,.28)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--void, #000); color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font: 10px/1.2 var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); } .ds-hud-panel header { min-height: 30px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border-bottom: .5px solid var(--structure, rgba(245,241,233,.28)); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-hud-panel header i { width: 4px; height: 4px; background: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); } .ds-hud-panel header strong { color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); } .ds-hud-panel div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 9px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--structure-weak, rgba(245,241,233,.15)); } .ds-hud-panel b { color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Agent Taskbar Slot
components.description: The single provider-neutral Agent launcher directly after Start, with dynamic provider and runtime status.
components.css: .ds-agent-slot { height: 56px; min-width: 176px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 4px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-right: .5px solid var(--structure, rgba(245,241,233,.28)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--void, #000); color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font-family: var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); text-align: left; } .ds-agent-slot svg { width: 24px; fill: none; stroke: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-agent-slot .ds-agent-core { fill: var(--ink-3, #837d75); } .ds-agent-slot span { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-agent-slot strong { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-agent-slot small { color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-agent-slot > i { width: 3px; height: 3px; background: var(--ink-3, #837d75); } .ds-agent-slot:hover { background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); } .ds-agent-slot:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-active { box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00) inset; } .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-active svg, .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-active small, .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-working svg, .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-working small { color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); stroke: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); } .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-working .ds-agent-core, .ds-agent-slot.ds-is-working > i { fill: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); background: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgb(255 106 0 / 38%); }

components.name: Explorer Ledger Row
components.description: A stable file row whose selection never shifts its geometry.
components.css: .ds-explorer-row { width: 100%; height: 46px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(180px,1fr) 120px 80px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--structure-weak, rgba(245,241,233,.15)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font: 10px/1 var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); text-align: left; } .ds-explorer-row strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-file-mark { width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); } .ds-explorer-row:hover { background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); } .ds-explorer-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-explorer-row:focus-visible .ds-file-mark { border-color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); background: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); }

components.name: Context Menu Command
components.description: A transient command overlay with compact icon, label, keyboard hint, and one shared desktop/Explorer/taskbar interaction grammar.
components.html: ITEM COMMANDS1 SELECTED
components.css: .ds-context-menu { width: 240px; border: .5px solid var(--structure-strong, rgba(245,241,233,.54)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface-0, #020202); color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); box-shadow: 8px 12px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 72%); font-family: var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); } .ds-context-menu header { height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 10px; border-bottom: .5px solid var(--structure, rgba(245,241,233,.28)); } .ds-context-menu header strong { color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-context-menu header small { color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); font-size: 8px; } .ds-context-menu button { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font: 10px/1 inherit; text-align: left; } .ds-context-menu svg { width: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; } .ds-context-menu kbd { color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); font: 8px/1 inherit; } .ds-context-menu button:hover, .ds-context-menu button:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); box-shadow: none; } .ds-context-menu button:hover svg, .ds-context-menu button:focus-visible svg { color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); }

components.name: Linked Agent Payload
components.description: A bounded one-shot context payload that truthfully identifies its source.
components.css: .ds-linked-payload { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 14px 13px 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 106 0 / 28%); border-radius: 0; background: rgb(255 106 0 / 2%); color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font-family: var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); } .ds-payload-node { width: 8px; height: 8px; justify-self: center; border: 1px solid var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); background: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgb(255 106 0 / 38%); } .ds-linked-payload > span:nth-child(2) { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-linked-payload small, .ds-linked-payload code { color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); font: 8px/1.2 inherit; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-linked-payload strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font: 600 10px/1.2 inherit; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-linked-payload button { align-self: stretch; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgba(245,241,233,.14); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font: 9px/1 inherit; } .ds-linked-payload button:hover, .ds-linked-payload button:focus-visible { outline: 0; color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00) inset; }

components.name: Actionable System Notice
components.description: A persistent warning or error notice with explicit recovery actions and assertive semantics.
components.html: WINDOW CONTROL FAILEDThe native operation did not complete. Retry or inspect system activity.
components.css: .ds-system-notice { width: min(560px, calc(100vw - 36px)); min-height: 58px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0,1fr) auto 32px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 10px 10px 14px; border: .5px solid var(--structure-strong, rgba(245,241,233,.54)); border-left: 2px solid var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); background: var(--void, #000); box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / 48%); font-family: var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); } .ds-system-notice.ds-is-warning, .ds-system-notice.ds-is-error { border-left-color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); } .ds-system-notice > svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); stroke-width: 1.25; } .ds-system-notice-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-system-notice-copy strong { color: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-system-notice-copy small { overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-system-notice-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-system-notice-actions button, .ds-system-notice-dismiss { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: .5px solid var(--structure-strong, rgba(245,241,233,.54)); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); background: transparent; font: 9px/1 inherit; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-system-notice-dismiss { width: 32px; padding: 0; } .ds-system-notice-actions button:hover, .ds-system-notice-actions button:focus-visible, .ds-system-notice-dismiss:hover, .ds-system-notice-dismiss:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); color: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); background: var(--signal-fill, rgb(255 106 0 / 4%)); } @media (max-width: 820px) { .ds-system-notice { width: calc(100vw - 16px); grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0,1fr) 32px; } .ds-system-notice-actions { grid-column: 2 / -1; } }

components.name: Knowledge Graph Signal
components.description: A truthful passive schema preview: neutral while disconnected, with orange reserved for a host-verified live relation.
components.html: <svg class="ds-knowledge-signal ds-is-disconnected" viewBox="0 0 320 120" role="img" aria-label="Knowledge source disconnected"><path class="ds-edge" d="M20 88 L102 26 L190 70 L300 20"></path><path class="ds-route" d="M20 88 L102 26 L190 70"></path><rect x="16" y="84" width="8" height="8"></rect><rect x="98" y="22" width="8" height="8"></rect><rect class="ds-hot" x="186" y="66" width="8" height="8"></rect><rect x="296" y="16" width="8" height="8"></rect><text x="202" y="73">SOURCE DISCONNECTED</text></svg>
components.css: .ds-knowledge-signal { width: 320px; height: 120px; background: var(--void, #000); color: var(--ink-3, #837d75); shape-rendering: geometricPrecision; } .ds-knowledge-signal path, .ds-knowledge-signal rect { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-knowledge-signal .ds-edge { fill: none; stroke: var(--structure, rgba(245,241,233,.28)); stroke-width: 1; opacity: .45; } .ds-knowledge-signal .ds-route { fill: none; stroke: var(--structure-strong, rgba(245,241,233,.54)); stroke-width: 1; opacity: .34; } .ds-knowledge-signal rect { fill: var(--ink-3, #837d75); } .ds-knowledge-signal text { fill: var(--ink-2, #c0bbb3); font: 600 9px/1 var(--font-data, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace); letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-knowledge-signal.ds-is-connected .ds-route { stroke: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); stroke-width: 1.25; stroke-dasharray: 10 8; opacity: 1; } .ds-knowledge-signal.ds-is-connected rect.ds-hot { fill: var(--signal-hot, #ff6a00); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgb(255 106 0 / 38%)); } .ds-knowledge-signal.ds-is-connected text { fill: var(--ink-1, #f5f1e9); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-knowledge-signal .ds-route { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
JARVIS is a tactical command environment, not a decorative science-fiction dashboard. The interface should feel like a black-box console owned by a highly technical operator: dense enough to support sustained code work, forceful enough to make active commands unmistakable, and disciplined enough that every mark can be traced to real state.

Black is operational space rather than a backdrop. Instrument White carries trusted information, Frame Gray exposes structure, and Command Orange arms the currently selected, connected, or executable path. The tone is militarized and decisive without becoming theatrical; hierarchy comes from contrast, alignment, and sparse signals before ornament.

The default material is flat and exact. Glass, gradients, rings, glow, scanning, and other dimensional effects are available design tools rather than forbidden motifs, but they earn their place only by clarifying hierarchy, mode, causality, or live system state.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, high-density geometry for code-centered work.
Warm-white facts, neutral structure, and sparse orange commands.
Square vector marks, hairline dividers, and tabular data alignment.
Motion reserved for transitions, active routes, and truthful live state.
Tactical, direct controls with visible keyboard and recovery affordances.

rules.name: The Armed Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange means selected, connected, executable, or live; an idle ornament does not receive the same authority.

rules.name: The Instrument White Rule
rules.body: Warm white carries facts and primary content. Orange may lead the eye, but it must not replace readable information.

rules.name: The Effects Need Clearance Rule
rules.body: Glass, gradients, cool accents, rings, glow, and scan motion are allowed when they reveal a real mode or state and remain subordinate to the black-white-orange command hierarchy.

rules.name: The Console Grammar Rule
rules.body: Commands are short, uppercase, and monospaced; explanations remain sentence case and readable.

rules.name: The One Readout Rule
rules.body: A region may have one dominant value or title. Supporting data steps down through size, weight, and ink before another accent is introduced.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Geometry is planar until interaction or truthful system state creates a reason for depth.

rules.name: The Local Emission Rule
rules.body: Glow stays attached to the node, line, edge, or control that owns the state; it does not wash across unrelated content.

dos: Do make the current command, selection, and causal relationship immediately identifiable through sparse Command Orange.
Do let Instrument White carry facts, filenames, commands, and results.
Do preserve the fixed shell geometry: compact rails, stable desktop slots, and a taskbar that leaves maximum width to real applications.
Do use point-line vector geometry for product-owned identity and system relationships.
Do attach animation and emission to real transitions or live state, and provide reduced-motion and forced-color behavior.
Do allow glass, gradients, rings, glow, scanning, or cool accents when a scoped mode genuinely benefits from them and the command hierarchy remains intact.
donts: Don't use orange everywhere; it loses command authority when every label or border competes for it.
Don't create false telemetry, false Agent capability, false file access, or decorative activity that reads as real system state.
Don't turn every region into an equally weighted framed card or reintroduce floating-window gutters around maximized work.
Don't duplicate the persistent Agent launcher in the top rail or desktop center.
Don't let labels, hover transforms, or badges move fixed icon coordinates or cause taskbar applications to jump.
Don't keep an idle scan or route animation running when it no longer communicates work, especially under reduced-motion preferences.
